description: ABI semantics of 8 x64 adapter callback slots. Versioned official Windows SDK declaration mirrored in pinned public repository; old Intel RVA map remains separate.

slots.name: pfnCalcPrivateDeviceSize
slots.purpose: Request private allocation size for driver device object

slots.name: pfnCreateDevice
slots.purpose: Create driver device; 5/5 Intel installed variants already match signature

slots.name: pfnFillDDITable
slots.purpose: Populate negotiated DDI tables; V04 core callback trace corroborates

qualification: WDK_SDK_ABI_LAYOUT_CORROBORATED_TWO_RELEASES; Intel RVAs structurally mapped in old study. Only CreateDevice and FillDDITable have traced driver implementation signatures; other six callbacks have ABI labels, not individually proven runtime behaviors.
limitations: Older and installed Intel drivers not dynamically hooked
Fortnite hung callback not identified from slot names
SDK 2015/2016 mirror, not an SDK source license grant
No proprietary driver bytes or disassembly distributed
repository_source_notice: Semantic extraction only. SDK header files remain at cited upstream source and are not vendored.
